messages:
morgan: Heads-up, PR #8943 adds wording about quota rollover for reserved capacity customers. Need a short snippet for the SDK examples, a burst-sim script for QA, and a Grafana color-threshold tweak for the quota panel. cc @eli @vik :eyes:

eli: Thanks — can you paste the exact text change? Want to avoid implying automatic rollovers for hosted users.

morgan: Sure — current draft: "Reserved capacity customers have an optional quota rollover window (configurable per-account). Unused allowance can be applied to short bursts within the next billing cycle if 'allow_rollover' is enabled."  We should add an explicit callout: "Hosted API customers are not eligible for rollover." Also suggest code snippet for SDK showing `allow_rollover: true/false`.

vik: I can do the SDK snippet. Which SDK version should we target? v4 or v5?

morgan: v5 is our target for the migration docs, but add a tiny note for v4 compatibility. Keep the snippet ~3 lines.

vik: Draft snippet:
```
// Node SDK v5
const res = await redwood.quota.updateAccount({
  accountId: 'acct_123',
  quota: { allow_rollover: true, monthly_limit: 100_000 }
});
```
add this to the quota page under "Account-level settings".

eli: That looks good. Add a single sentence explaining server-side enforcement and that toggling only affects the next billing period.

qa_sam: QA needs a deterministic way to reproduce bursts for the e2e test. Can someone drop a small bash script that hits the usage endpoint at X tps for 30s? Also we need expected logs sample.

morgan: Putting a quick sim here (bash + curl):
```
# burst-sim.sh — run from CI runner
for i in {1..300}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/usage/events \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
    -d '{"account_id":"acct_123","units":50}' &
  sleep 0.1
done
wait
```
Expected: panel spikes to ~15k units/min, and if `allow_rollover=false` we should see immediate throttles in the logs.

leo: Grafana panel note: current threshold colors are green/yellow/red at 50/80/95%. For rollover accounts we want a new intermediate color at 60% labelled "buffer" and tooltip text: "Buffer used from rollover allowance". Panel id: grafana:dash-usage:panel-7 — updating thresholds should be a one-line change in the panel JSON.

eli: Also a link fix — the quota page currently links to /docs/metering/usage-terms which 404s. It should point to /docs/pricing/usage-terms. I'll include the link edit in the PR.

morgan: Ownership: vik will add SDK snippet + v4 note. eli will update wording and link. leo will send the panel JSON diff to eng-infra. qa_sam will add the burst-sim CI job and expected log snippet. I'll open the docs PR and tag reviewers. Target: merge by EOD Thursday. :shipit:

docs-bot: PR created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8943 — reviewers: @vik @eli @qa_sam

vik: On it, will push a small follow-up commit with the snippet and a 1-liner v4 compatibility note.

qa_sam: I'll add the CI job in a separate test-only PR and link it here when ready.

morgan: Thanks all. If anyone finds phrasing that could confuse hosted vs dedicated customers ping me before merge. :wave:
